meta.title: Weights cannot be added to a draft round through this action
gaps: act 1: PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}}/edit_weight_parameters is sent with no body — a request step carries the body the case writes (or a library/operation step has a working one)
The valid lot weight request body is not provided, and its fields are not in the allowed vocabulary; therefore the PATCH request cannot be represented without inventing fields.
